scenes.visual: Title card: A Veto, Not an Instruction.

scenes.tts: Numb goes into the daughter that does not hear Notch. Is Numb an instruction, or a veto?
scenes.visual: A gold Numb daughter beside a teal sister. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: Numb goes into the daughter that does not hear Notch. Is Numb an instruction, or a veto?

scenes.tts: You now hold two facts. At each division, Notch decides between the daughters. And Numb goes into one daughter only.
scenes.visual: Fact 1 and fact 2 appear as two short lines beside the tree.
scenes.narration: You now hold two facts. At each division, Notch decides between the daughters. And Numb goes into one daughter only.

scenes.tts: Put them side by side. At the first division, Numb goes to the inner precursor, which does not hear Notch.
scenes.visual: Table builds. Row 1: Numb daughter, inner precursor (grey); sister, outer precursor (teal).
scenes.narration: Put them side by side. At the first division, Numb goes to the inner precursor, which does not hear Notch.

scenes.tts: At the outer precursor's division, Numb goes to the hair cell. At the inner precursor's, it goes to the neuron.
scenes.visual: Rows 2 and 3: hair cell and neuron in gold-outlined grey; socket and sheath in teal.
scenes.narration: At the outer precursor's division, Numb goes to the hair cell. At the inner precursor's, it goes to the neuron.

scenes.tts: At every division, the Numb daughter is the Notch-off daughter. Two readings fit that.
scenes.visual: The Numb column highlights in gold; every cell in it is grey.
scenes.narration: At every division, the Numb daughter is the Notch-off daughter. Two readings fit that.

scenes.tts: Perhaps Numb is an instruction. It tells the cell what to become. A cell without Numb cannot take that fate.
scenes.visual: Instruction panel: Numb carries a note into the nucleus that names a fate.
scenes.narration: Perhaps Numb is an instruction. It tells the cell what to become. A cell without Numb cannot take that fate.

scenes.tts: Or perhaps Numb is a veto. It carries no message of its own. It only blocks Notch.
scenes.visual: Veto panel, a functional schematic: in the Numb cell the Notch signalling arrow is crossed out, labelled Notch response blocked. No note. Numb is not drawn plugging the receptor.
scenes.narration: Or perhaps Numb is a veto. It carries no message of its own. It only blocks Notch.

scenes.tts: Then a cell with Numb takes whatever fate a cell without Notch would take.
scenes.visual: In the veto panel, the Numb cell and a cell with no Notch take the same grey fate.
scenes.narration: Then a cell with Numb takes whatever fate a cell without Notch would take.

scenes.tts: Both predict the numb mutant, where every daughter hears Notch. To tell them apart, take Notch away too.
scenes.visual: Both panels show the numb mutant: every daughter teal. A label: both models agree.
scenes.narration: Both predict the numb mutant, where every daughter hears Notch. To tell them apart, take Notch away too.

scenes.tts: Which single mutant does the double mutant resemble? That reading is called epistasis analysis.
scenes.visual: Label: double mutant, Notch and numb both gone. Term card: epistasis analysis.
scenes.narration: Which single mutant does the double mutant resemble? That reading is called epistasis analysis.

scenes.tts: The test case is M P two, a precursor in the fly's central nervous system. It makes two neurons, d M P two and v M P two.
scenes.caption: The test case is MP2, a precursor in the fly's central nervous system. It makes two neurons, dMP2 and vMP2.
scenes.visual: A precursor labelled MP2 in a schematic fly nerve cord divides into two neurons labelled dMP2 (grey, gold Numb outline) and vMP2 (teal).
scenes.narration: The test case is MP2, a precursor in the fly's central nervous system. It makes two neurons, dMP2 and vMP2.

scenes.tts: Here the Notch signal comes from cells outside the lineage, not from the sister.
scenes.visual: Neighbouring cells outside the MP2 lineage send a Notch arrow to the vMP2 side.
scenes.narration: Here the Notch signal comes from cells outside the lineage, not from the sister.

scenes.tts: Notch mutants make two d M P two neurons. Numb mutants make two v M P two neurons.
scenes.caption: Notch mutants make two dMP2 neurons. Numb mutants make two vMP2 neurons.
scenes.visual: Genotype grid: wild type, one of each; Notch, dMP2 and dMP2; numb, vMP2 and vMP2; double mutant, blank.
scenes.narration: Notch mutants make two dMP2 neurons. Numb mutants make two vMP2 neurons.

scenes.tts: What should a fly lacking both make, if Numb is an instruction? And if it is a veto?
scenes.visual: The double-mutant cell of the grid flashes. Both cartoon panels sit above it.
scenes.narration: What should a fly lacking both make, if Numb is an instruction? And if it is a veto?

scenes.visual: Hold on the prompt. A small timer icon.

scenes.tts: If Numb were an instruction, the double mutant could make no d M P two.
scenes.caption: If Numb were an instruction, the double mutant could make no dMP2.
scenes.visual: Instruction panel: with no Numb note, the dMP2 fate is crossed out.
scenes.narration: If Numb were an instruction, the double mutant could make no dMP2.

scenes.tts: A veto has nothing to block once Notch is gone. So the double mutant should look like the Notch mutant.
scenes.visual: Veto panel: with no Notch receptor, there is nothing for Numb to block. Both cells turn grey.
scenes.narration: A veto has nothing to block once Notch is gone. So the double mutant should look like the Notch mutant.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-six, Eric Spana and Chris Doe found two d M P two neurons.
scenes.caption: In 1996, Eric Spana and Chris Doe found two dMP2 neurons.
scenes.visual: Name card: Spana and Doe, 1996. The double-mutant cell of the grid fills in: dMP2, dMP2.
scenes.narration: In 1996, Eric Spana and Chris Doe found two dMP2 neurons.

scenes.visual: Hold on the reveal.

scenes.tts: Numb is not needed to make d M P two. It is needed only to stop Notch.
scenes.caption: Numb is not needed to make dMP2. It is needed only to stop Notch.
scenes.visual: The instruction panel fades; the veto panel stays.
scenes.narration: Numb is not needed to make dMP2. It is needed only to stop Notch.

scenes.tts: That earns the rule. The daughter that inherits Numb cannot hear Notch, so it takes the Notch-off fate of that division.
scenes.visual: Rule card: the daughter that inherits Numb cannot hear Notch, so it takes the Notch-off fate of that division.
scenes.narration: That earns the rule. The daughter that inherits Numb cannot hear Notch, so it takes the Notch-off fate of that division.

scenes.tts: The rule names a side, not a fate. The Notch-off fate may be the inner precursor, the hair cell or d M P two.
scenes.caption: The rule names a side, not a fate. The Notch-off fate may be the inner precursor, the hair cell or dMP2.
scenes.visual: Three grey cells side by side: inner precursor, hair cell, dMP2. Label: Notch-off side.
scenes.narration: The rule names a side, not a fate. The Notch-off fate may be the inner precursor, the hair cell or dMP2.

scenes.tts: In these lineages, both sisters go on to differentiate. So Notch is not the stem cell signal here.
scenes.visual: The teal partners appear: outer precursor, socket cell, vMP2. All are differentiating cells.
scenes.narration: In these lineages, both sisters go on to differentiate. So Notch is not the stem cell signal here.

scenes.tts: Numb needs its phosphotyrosine-binding domain to block Notch.
scenes.visual: A schematic of the Numb protein with its PTB domain highlighted. Brief inset: the PTB domain structure, PDB 1DDM.
scenes.narration: Numb needs its phosphotyrosine-binding domain to block Notch.

scenes.tts: It does not need that domain to form its crescent. Reaching one side and vetoing Notch are separate jobs.
scenes.visual: Numb without the domain still forms a gold crescent, but the Notch receptor beside it stays on.
scenes.narration: It does not need that domain to form its crescent. Reaching one side and vetoing Notch are separate jobs.

scenes.tts: Numb is a veto, not an instruction. Without Notch, there is nothing to veto.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: Numb is a veto on Notch, not an instruction.
scenes.narration: Numb is a veto, not an instruction. Without Notch, there is nothing to veto.

scenes.visual: Hold on the takeaway card.
